counterhypotheses.claim: Canonical semantic hash/parity is sufficient for release evidence; extra byte/build/admission identity is redundant bureaucracy.
counterhypotheses.discriminator: Hold semantic hash constant while changing selected surface/build input or tested bytes; accept only if explicit equivalence/provenance evidence proves the same admitted artifact.

counterhypotheses.claim: Sparse historical NAcc exact-call results are a static-search artifact; most defined channels may be active through aliases/dynamic dispatch/unsearched paths.
counterhypotheses.discriminator: Instrument every runtime reward invocation and downstream E-PQ/reentry effect over frozen golden traces plus autonomous/idle paths.

counterhypotheses.claim: Targeted dependency routing is unsafe under incomplete/stale projections and the correctness machinery can erase most transport gain; dense broadcast may dominate.
counterhypotheses.supporting_internal: Single-view candidate missed 603 required deliveries with 8% hidden edges. Late dual-view+reconciliation synthetic evidence reached eventual recall 1.0 but needed 8.034 send attempts/event vs 9.0 broadcast, reducing modeled send-attempt gain to ~10.7%.
counterhypotheses.discriminator: Real-repo broadcast/tag-only/adaptive dual-view replay with missing/stale/duplicate/reorder/restart faults and total payload/control/resource accounting.

counterhypotheses.claim: A same-database live observer is harmless and isolation adds needless complexity.
counterhypotheses.discriminator: No-observer vs same-file vs isolated observer on current SQLite family; compare writer p50/p95/p99, SQLITE_BUSY/retries, WAL bytes, checkpoint latency, replay correctness and stale window.

counterhypotheses.claim: A simple scalar causal-outcome reward is sufficient; typed/multihorizon reward adds complexity without control benefit.
counterhypotheses.discriminator: Historical measured reward function vs scalar causal-outcome vs typed vs typed+multihorizon under matched episodes, stability and resource shadows.

counterhypotheses.claim: A broker's exactly-once mode can stand in for Clay effect idempotency and authority checks.
counterhypotheses.discriminator: Crash after external effect but before semantic effect receipt; replay must produce zero duplicate effects independent of broker redelivery behavior.

counterhypotheses.claim: Every causal receipt must be individually fsynced immediately; any group/transaction batching creates an unacceptable delivered-but-not-durable audit window.
counterhypotheses.supporting_internal: Selective-sync shadow replayed all modeled records and was ~2.714x faster but was correctly NOT_SELECTED because power-loss/immediate-durability semantics were unproven.
counterhypotheses.discriminator: Hostinger strict-per-record vs UnifiedDB transaction/group-commit with process crash, torn tail, power-loss surrogate, effect idempotency and 100% authoritative fallback replay equivalence.

rule: Counterhypotheses remain alternatives/failure modes; none is promoted merely by repetition or external resemblance.
